name: Nièvre
note: Since the 2022 publicity reform the Département publishes each arrêté/décision individually in the 'kiosque/arretes' shared-files list (one page, ~6.4k PDF links all years). Only acts numbered D-2026-* or published _ART_2026MMDD. URLs /shared-files/<id>/?<name>.pdf carry a query string -> URL-hash doc_id suffix (us_pdf_list). robots.txt: Disallow empty.

name: Corrèze
note: 'La publication des actes': per-session compilations (CP/CD délibérations, arrêtés du Président) as PDFs under /sites/default/files/; 2026 only. robots.txt has no Disallow.

name: Loiret
note: 'Les arrêtés administratifs du Département' (Drupal view, 20/page, ?page=N, newest first); files /sites/loiret/files/media/administrative-acts/2026/MM/. Link text is 'Téléchargement' -> file name used as title. robots: only /core/ /profiles/ README disallowed.
